checkpoints.question: Why does a second publisher need `__node:=talker_two` or another unique node name?
checkpoints.model_answer: Node names must be unique in a ROS 2 graph. Without remapping, the second publisher would conflict with the existing `/talker` name.

evidence.label: Give a second publisher a unique node name

checkpoints.question: Why must both the publisher and subscriber remap `chatter:=greeting`?
checkpoints.model_answer: Both endpoints must refer to the same topic. Remapping only one leaves the publisher and subscriber on different names.

evidence.label: Remap both ends of a topic
